subject: alt-c-pg
title: ALT.C.PG.------T.C.IMP.
description: Diagram in the Post-Cage Continuum section (PCC-3), opening Braxton's three-fold division of extension: restructuralism, stylism, and extended application of traditional functionalism. (C)ALT-C-PG (alternative composite progressionalism) is crossed with T-C-IMP (time continuum implications): the question is what alternative composite progressionalism implies for the time continuum at the moment when the post-Cage continuum has run thirty years. CULT-INFO-DY (culture information dynamics) and T-C-IMP both feed ALT-C-PG. ALT-C-PG → ALT-F (alternative functionalism) → INFO-DE-B (a diagram-only term, likely 'information determination basis') → PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics). ALT-F also → PROG-CONT (progressional continuance), and PROG-CONT has a *dashed* edge to AFL-DY (affinity dynamics). (P)RE-ST (the point of activation of restructuralism) has *dashed* edges to PR-TRS (primary transition) and ALT-F. Structural argument: alternative composite progressionalism, when crossed with time-continuum implications, produces alternative functionalism — and alternative functionalism reaches projectional dynamics only via the determination-basis intermediary. The dashed edges from progressional-continuance to affinity-dynamics, and from the point-of-activation of restructuralism to both primary-transition and alternative-functionalism, mark these connections as conditional — meaning the post-Cage continuum's productive outputs (real change in affinity dynamics, real primary transition) only conditionally activate at the point-of-activation of restructuralism, even though the structural chain is in place.
